inbox.badge: {count, plural, one {# approval waiting} other {# approvals waiting}}
panic.title: Stop everything?
panic.body: Kills {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, pauses {schedules, plural, one {# schedule} other {# schedules}}, disconnects {channels, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}}, and tells {clouds, plural, =0 {no cloud daemons} one {# cloud daemon} other {# cloud daemons}} to do the same. Nothing restarts until you resume.
panic.resumeBody: Check what was running before you bring it back.
panic.resumeN: {count, plural, =0 {Resume without agents} one {Resume # selected} other {Resume # selected}}
offline.banner: Offline. Showing what was cached. Approvals you make now are sent when you're back online.
demo.banner: Demo data. Nothing here is connected to a real daemon.
update.ready: A new version of beamhop is ready.
pair.enter.title: Pair this device
pair.enter.body: Scan the QR code your computer shows with this phone’s camera. No camera here? Type the 8-character code instead.
pair.enter.label: Pairing code
pair.enter.hint: 8 letters and digits. Paste works; the dash is optional.
pair.enter.invalid: The code is 8 letters and digits, like AMBR-RLY8.
pair.where.title: Where’s the code?
pair.where.body: On your computer: Settings → Devices → Pair a device. Or in a terminal:
pair.invalid: That link isn’t a pairing link, or it was cut off. Scan the QR again or type the code.
pair.expired.title: This code expired.
pair.expired.body: Pairing codes last 2 minutes. Get a new one on your computer, then scan again.
pair.compare.title: Pair with your computer
pair.compare.body: Name this device, then send the request. Your computer will show the same 4 words before it lets this device in.
pair.compare.notMine: I didn’t scan a code on my computer
pair.name.label: Device name
pair.name.hint: Shown in Settings → Devices, so you can remove it later.
pair.error.title: Couldn’t reach your computer.
pair.error.body: Check that beamhop is running there and the code hasn’t expired.
pair.phrase.hint: Remember nothing. You’ll just check your computer shows the same words.
pair.confirm.title: Confirm on your computer
pair.confirm.body: Your computer now shows 4 words for {name}. If they match these, press Yes, pair there.
pair.cancelled.title: Pairing cancelled.
pair.cancelled.body: Nothing was paired. Press No, cancel on your computer too, then start again with a fresh code.
pair.done.title: Paired · {name}
pair.done.body: This device can now approve requests and stop agents. Two more steps make that work from your pocket.
pair.install.title: Install beamhop
pair.install.why: Installed, it opens like an app and keeps working when the browser is closed.
pair.install.why.ios: iPhone only sends approval alerts to installed apps.
pair.install.menu: Use your browser menu → Install app.
pair.push.title: Get approvals on this phone?
pair.push.body: You’ll be notified when an agent needs a decision, a budget runs out, or an agent stops. Nothing else.
pair.push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your system settings, or get alerts as Nostr DMs instead (Settings → Notifications).
pair.push.later: You can turn them on any time in Settings → Notifications.
pair.push.needsInstall: Install beamhop first. iPhone needs iOS 16.4+ and the installed app for notifications.
pair.push.unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications. Alerts can come as Nostr DMs instead.
